features: Seamless Gaming with 6.5 Gbps Wi-Fi 7—— Experience seamless gameplay and unmatched speed with 5765 Mbps on 5 GHz and 688 Mbps on 2.4 GHz, powered by Wi-Fi 7’s MLO and 4K-QAM.
Six Antennas for Ultimate Coverage—— Six high-performance antennas enhanced with Beamforming technology offer expansive coverage and reliable connections.
Two 2.5G Ports to Empower Your Games—— Go full throttle with two 2.5G LAN ports for up to 2.5× faster data-transfer speeds.
Unstoppable Turbo Game Acceleration—— Accelerate game applications, game devices, mobile games, and game servers. Stabilize connections, minimize jitter, lag, and ping while boosting speed.

Unique Racing Car Style Design—— Archer GE400 fuels gaming passion with its sleek, race car-inspired look. Customizable RGB lighting adds a dynamic glow, making it a striking focal point in any gamer's setup.

Dedicated Game Panel——An intuitive game panel provides real-time insights into the game environment, including network status, router performance, RGB settings, accelerated games and gears, enabling players to strategize effectively.

EasyMesh Compatibility—— Works with EasyMesh routers and range extenders to form seamless whole home Mesh Wi-Fi. This connectivity ensures consistent coverage, allowing gamers to collaborate efficiently and dominate multiplayer.

TP-Link HomeShield——HomeShield offers robust antivirus protection for a secure gaming experience. It defends all your devices and personal data against online threats, ensuring peace of mind while gaming.

Future-Ready Wi-Fi 7 - Designed with the latest Wi-Fi 7 technology, featuring Multi-Link Operation (MLO), Multi-RUs, and 4K-QAM. Achieve optimized performance on latest WiFi 7 laptops and devices, like the iPhone 16 Pro, and Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra.

6-Stream, Dual-Band Wi-Fi with 6.5 Gbps Total Bandwidth - Achieve full speeds of up to 5764 Mbps on the 5GHz band and 688 Mbps on the 2.4 GHz band with 6 streams. Enjoy seamless 4K/8K streaming, AR/VR gaming, and incredibly fast downloads/uploads.

Wide Coverage with Strong Connection - Get up to 2,400 sq. ft. max coverage for up to 90 devices at a time. 6x high performance antennas and Beamforming technology, ensures reliable connections for remote workers, gamers, students, and more.

Ultra-Fast 2.5 Gbps Wired Performance - 1x 2.5 Gbps WAN/LAN port, 1x 2.5 Gbps LAN port and 3x 1 Gbps LAN ports offer high-speed data transmissions.3 Integrate with a multi-gig modem for gigplus internet.
description: Future-proof your home with the Archer BE400, a Wi-Fi 7 BE6500 router that delivers fast, reliable coverage throughout your home. It is built with cutting-edge Wi-Fi 7 technology, featuring Multi-Link Operating (MLO), Multi-RUs, and 4K-QAM, ensuring exceptional speed and reliability for both wired and wireless internet connections. Whether you’re streaming Netflix, Prime Video, or Disney+, or browsing at ultra-fast speeds on your Wi-Fi 7 devices, like the iPhone 16 Pro, the Google Pixel 9, or PS5 Pro, this router delivers top-tier performance. Increase the security of your home network by setting up a separate WiFi SSID for IoT devices, using the included HomeShield feature in the Tether app and advanced WPA3 encryption. This reduces the risk of unauthorized access to sensitive data or devices.
